title: 10 嗜血飞蚁11 怨灵12 尸坟丘
content_zh:
果然不出洛豪所料，不到半个小时之后，虚灵虎就停了下来，此时只有茫茫的一片荒原，那里还有洛豪的踪迹，虚灵虎开始朝天大吼，想要表达自己的愤怒。
可是就在虚灵虎大吼的那一瞬间，看到前方的一幕，顿时吓得赶紧逃跑了。
如果洛豪在这里，绝对会感叹太可怕了，因为在虚灵虎的前方一公里处黑压压的一大片，全是嗜血飞蚁。
那些飞蚁专门以灵兽或者人类修士的精血为食，而且不论灵兽多大的体型，都能杀死，就算是灵兽也十分忌惮嗜血飞蚁，这是群居的灵兽。
单体实力可能不怎么样，但是群体实力，就是一群结真初期的嗜血飞蚁也能够干掉一头成丹期的灵兽了。
所以虚灵虎看到了飞蚁之后，二话不说就逃走了。
而当那些飞蚁听到了虚灵虎的大吼之后，就发现了虚灵虎，都蜂拥着朝虚灵虎追来。
洛豪的运气不错，因为在洛豪擦掉血迹快速逃走的几分钟之后，虚灵虎就失去了方向，然后走错了方向，追到了嗜血飞蚁的老巢。
虚灵虎的速度虽然比不上洛豪，但还是比嗜血飞蚁快得多，何况嗜血飞蚁的实力几乎都是结真初期，速度自然就比虚灵虎差得多了。
只是让虚灵虎想不到的是，嗜血飞蚁一直将它追出了横断山谷入口，这份执着精神就是洛豪在这里，估计也惊叹不已。
也不知道是什么原因，嗜血飞蚁居然不会飞出横断山谷，当它们发现虚灵虎已经逃出了横断山谷之后，又蜂拥着转身回了自己的老巢，而此时虚灵虎站在横断山谷外非常的愤怒，周围不少低级的灵兽都被虚灵虎给吓跑了。
吴邪来到横断山谷的时候，正好发现了虚灵虎，吴邪气势散开，竟然拿出了一把长枪，长枪划过数道响亮的枪芒，数道枪芒瞬间形成了一个包围圈罩，将虚灵虎给笼罩住了。
虚灵虎在吴邪发动攻击的时候就注意到了，只是可惜它发现这个人类修士的实力远远超过了它，所以它甚至来不及反抗就被枪芒给撕裂，只听砰的一声，虚灵虎被枪芒席卷了起来，然后尸体又径直落了下去。
虽然灵兽实力在境界相同的情况下比人类修士强，但是吴邪和虚灵虎的实力相差实在太大，所以只是一个照面，洛豪眼中难以对付的虚灵虎就被吴邪给杀了。
杀了虚灵虎之后，吴邪看都没看一眼虚灵虎的尸体，只是随手一带，就将虚灵虎的一级灵兽内丹给摄取在了手中，然后冲进了横断山谷。
吴邪不用多想也知道洛豪一前往了横断山脉深处，所以毫不犹豫的就追了过去。
洛豪如果在这里，肯定会震惊，不过这些都不是此时洛豪关心的事情了，因为洛豪已经来到了横断山谷的出口。
走出了横断山谷，果然前方充满了无数的瘴气，只不过这个地方不是洛豪之前第一次来的时候所呆过的地方。
这个地方距离瘴气比较近，所以周围也并没有什么灵草，就是灵兽也没有看到，只不过洛豪倒是看见了许多尸骸，有很多尸骸看起来更像是人类修士的，也有许多灵兽的尸骸，洛豪看到这里有些惊奇，难道这里曾经发生过修士与灵兽之间的大战不成?
洛豪释放出了神识，开始小心翼翼的探查周围的情况。越往前走，洛豪越来越心惊，因为方圆二公里除了到处可见的尸骸之外，竟然看不到其它的东西。

看这些尸骸，洛豪也知道死去的年份也不久了，也不知道他们到底是发生大战还是中了瘴气的毒而死，想到这里，洛豪忽然一惊，他可没有解毒丹，这要怎么防备里面的瘴气，而且他也不知道这瘴气到底是种什么样的毒。
洛豪开始使用神识沟通混沌书，想要从混沌书中找到有关瘴气的介绍。
不一会儿，一段信息文字就出现在了脑海里，与此同时，洛豪也知道了横断山谷中的瘴气是什么样的毒了。
这是一种尸体腐烂而形成的剧毒，一旦修士吸进了瘴气，就是聚婴期的高手都有可能瞬间毙命，更不要说洛豪一个小小的结真初期巅峰了。
难怪这里那么多的尸骸，而且这里也被列为修士的禁地。
洛豪皱了皱眉头，开始沉思自己是否要进去。
content_en:
As expected by Luo Hao, the Void Spirit Tiger stopped less than half an hour later. At this time, there was only a vast wasteland, and there were traces of Luo Hao there. The Void Spirit Tiger began to roar toward the sky, wanting to express its anger.
But at the moment when the virtual spirit tiger roared, he saw the scene in front of him and was immediately frightened and ran away.
If Luo Hao were here, he would definitely lament how terrible it is, because a large area of ​​black mass one kilometer in front of the Void Spirit Tiger is filled with bloodthirsty flying ants.
Those flying ants specifically feed on the essence and blood of spiritual beasts or human monks, and they can kill the spiritual beasts no matter how big they are. Even spiritual beasts are very afraid of bloodthirsty flying ants, which are spiritual beasts that live in groups.
The individual strength may not be that great, but with group strength, even a group of bloodthirsty flying ants in the early stage of formation can kill a spirit beast in the elixir stage.
So after seeing the flying ants, the virtual spirit tiger ran away without saying a word.
And when the flying ants heard the roar of the virtual spirit tiger, they discovered the virtual spirit tiger, and they all swarmed towards the virtual spirit tiger.
Luo Hao was lucky, because a few minutes after Luo Hao wiped off the blood and ran away quickly, the virtual spirit tiger lost its direction, then went in the wrong direction and chased the bloodthirsty flying ants' nest.
Although the speed of the Void Spirit Tiger is not as fast as Luo Hao's, it is still much faster than the Bloodthirsty Flying Ants. What's more, the strength of the Bloodthirsty Flying Ants are almost all in the early stage of Realization, so their speed is naturally much worse than that of the Void Spirit Tiger.
What the Void Spirit Tiger didn't expect was that the bloodthirsty flying ants chased it out of the entrance of the Hengduan Valley. This persistence was what made Luo Hao here, and he was probably amazed.
For some unknown reason, the bloodthirsty flying ants would not fly out of the Hengduan Valley. When they discovered that the Void Spirit Tiger had escaped from the Hengduan Valley, they swarmed back to their home nest. At this time, the Void Spirit Tiger stood outside the Hengduan Valley and was very angry. Many low-level spiritual beasts around were scared away by the Void Spirit Tiger.
When Wu Xie came to the Hengduan Valley, he happened to find the Void Spirit Tiger. Wu Xie's momentum spread and he actually took out a long spear. The spear passed through several loud gun rays. The several gun rays instantly formed an encirclement, covering the Void Spirit Tiger.
The Void Spirit Tiger noticed when Wu Xie launched the attack, but unfortunately it found that the strength of the human monk far exceeded it, so it was torn apart by the gun light before it even had time to resist. With a bang, the Void Spirit Tiger was swept up by the gun light, and then the body fell straight down.
Although the strength of spiritual beasts is stronger than that of human monks at the same level, the difference in strength between Wu Xie and the virtual spirit tiger is too big, so just a face-to-face encounter, the virtual spirit tiger that Luo Hao thought was difficult to deal with was killed by Wu Xie.
After killing the Void Spirit Tiger, Wu Xie didn't even glance at the Void Spirit Tiger's body. He just took the Void Spirit Tiger's first-level spiritual beast inner elixir into his hands, and then rushed into the Hengduan Valley.
Wu Xie didn't need to think too much to know that Luo Hao had gone deep into the Hengduan Mountains, so he chased after him without hesitation.
If Luo Hao were here, he would definitely be shocked, but these are not things Luo Hao cares about at this time, because Luo Hao has already arrived at the exit of Hengduan Valley.
After walking out of the Hengduan Valley, it turned out that the front was filled with countless miasmas, but this place was not the place Luo Hao had stayed before when he first came here.
This place is relatively close to the miasma, so there are no spiritual grasses around, not even spiritual beasts. However, Luo Hao saw many corpses. Many corpses looked more like those of human monks, and there were also many corpses of spiritual beasts. Luo Hao was a little surprised when he saw this place. Could it be that there had been a battle between monks and spiritual beasts here?
Luo Hao released his spiritual consciousness and began to carefully explore the surrounding situation. The further he walked, the more frightened Luo Hao became, because apart from the corpses that could be seen everywhere within a two-kilometer radius, he could not see anything else.West.
Looking at these corpses, Luo Hao also knew that the year of death was not long ago, and he did not know whether they had a big battle or were poisoned by miasma. Thinking of this, Luo Hao was suddenly shocked. He did not have an antidote pill, so how could he guard against the miasma inside, and he did not know what kind of poison this miasma was.
Luo Hao began to use his spiritual consciousness to communicate with the Chaos Book, hoping to find an introduction to miasma from the Chaos Book.
After a while, a message text appeared in his mind. At the same time, Luo Hao also knew what kind of poison the miasma in the Hengduan Valley was.
This is a kind of poison formed by the decay of corpses. Once a monk inhales the miasma, even a master in the infant gathering stage may be killed instantly, let alone a small Luo Hao who is in the early stage of peak Jie Zhen.
No wonder there are so many corpses here, and it is also listed as a forbidden area for monks.
Luo Hao frowned and began to ponder whether he should go in.
